learner_operation: Locate a highlighted matrix entry, count its one-based row and column, and express the ordered indices in matrix-entry notation.

fixed_features.feature: One highlighted cell and one-based row before column
Small integer matrices; five radio options or source-supported symbolic/two-index blanks
fixed_features.justification: All nine source cases use these response workloads. Matrix values do not determine coordinates.

Conservative distractor extension preserves complete source banks; fixing their correct role is not justified. Current sampler instead chooses a bank placement with at least two in-matrix targets and varies the highlighted target.

coverage.result: Nine cases match complete answer banks and matrices. q139629 highlight restored from keys/solution; canonical example is an instructional demonstration without fields.

delivery.result: Current exact batch 5/5 survives; fresh overlapping-seed candidates 7/10 survive with contrasting bank targets. Previous bound broader sample retains 32/40 fresh and 46/56 controlled records. Generator construction, requested difficulty, shared filtering, captured inventory and selection rules examined. Individual history may remove previously seen partners.

limitations: No finite audit proves absence of all shortcuts. Conditional small groups are regression examples, not population estimates.
Review targets easy only. Authored moderate/hard are not certified.
No live learner histories, policy distribution or later inventory; selection claims are limited to captured basis5667 and inspected code.
Source replay preserves original answer arrangement by design and is not itself a varied practice pool.
Serialized option-position probes are distinguished from actual preview UI order; learner item IDs are unavailable.
Earlier broader evidence is reused with provenance because runtime/source/batch/inventory bindings match. Native outcomes were rerun against the changed engine; scope remains easy only.
